name: How can I prevent my toilet from overflowing?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent my toilet from overflowing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing toilet overflows involves a few key practices. Avoid flushing anything other than human waste and toilet paper. Be mindful of the amount of toilet paper used, especially with older or low-flow toilets. Regularly clean your toilet to prevent mineral buildup that can restrict drainage. If you have a slow-draining toilet, address it promptly before it becomes a full clog. Consider periodic professional drain cleaning for older homes or persistent issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent overflows by only flushing human waste and toilet paper, using less toilet paper, and addressing slow drains promptly. Regular cleaning also helps.
